=== Format ===
'''Games start: <mark>11:00</mark>'''<br />
* '''Double Elimination Bracket'''
**{{Abbr|BO3|Best of Three}} games
**Procedure: <mark>/cmd rnd</mark> <kbd>Pick</kbd> <kbd>Pick</kbd> <code>Toss</code> <code>Toss</code> <code>Toss</code> <code>Toss</code> <code>Toss</code> <code>Toss</code> <mark>Play</mark>
** ''Winner of /cmd rnd picks and tosses first.''

**{{Abbr|BO5|Best of Five}} games
**Procedure:  <mark>/cmd rnd</mark> <kbd>Pick</kbd> <kbd>Pick</kbd> <kbd>Pick</kbd> <kbd>Pick</kbd> <code>Toss</code> <code>Toss</code> <code>Toss</code> <code>Toss</code> <mark>Play</mark> 
** ''Winner of /cmd rnd picks and tosses first.''
<pre>Map picks alternate by default.

Exception: if a player is trailing 0-2 in maps, that player picks the 3rd map, and the opposing player picks the 4th map.
Result: both players will have picked two maps each before the toss stage.</pre>

*'''Grand Finals'''
**Grand Finals is {{Abbr|BO7|Best of Seven}}.
**Procedure: <mark>/cmd rnd</mark> <kbd>Pick</kbd> <kbd>Pick</kbd> <kbd>Pick</kbd> <kbd>Pick</kbd> <kbd>Pick</kbd> <kbd>Pick</kbd> <code>Toss</code> <code>Toss</code> <mark>Play</mark>
** ''Winner of /cmd rnd picks and tosses first.''
**Picks alternate unless one player is trailing map score.
